description: Financial advisors, insurance brokers, tax consultants, accounting, wealth management
typical_workflows: Client advisory: Needs analysis, product recommendation, closing
Application processing: Insurance applications, loan applications
Portfolio management: Contract overview, follow-ups, cancellations
Claims processing: Claims reporting, communication with insurers
Regulatory compliance: Training, GDPR, compliance requirements
common_pain_points: High documentation requirements: Regulatory bodies, compliance
Complex products: Constantly new rates and conditions
Time-consuming administration: 40-50% of time on admin tasks
Advisory protocols: Every conversation must be documented
Creating comparisons: Manual rate comparisons are time-intensive
Client communication: Many inquiries about contracts/claims
Commission calculation: Complex calculations, many interfaces
ai_opportunities: Automate advisory protocols: Meeting → Transcript → Protocol
AI-powered rate analysis: Quick analysis of conditions
Automated customer inquiry responses: FAQ bot for standard questions
Claims processing: Automatic categorization and routing
Contract analysis: Analyze PDFs, find coverage gaps
Lead qualification: Automatic evaluation of inquiries
Newsletter generation: Market updates for existing clients
typical_tools: CRM systems: Salesforce, HubSpot, industry-specific platforms
PDF processing for contracts and documents
Accounting software: QuickBooks, Xero, cloud solutions
